view.scene_description: A blurry interior shot of a brightly lit supermarket aisle. Shelves on both sides are stocked with colorful canned goods, snacks, and packaged items. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling. A person walks down the center aisle toward a refrigerated section in the background. Red promotional signage is visible above the aisle.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing dark clothing and carrying a bag walks down the central aisle. Their back faces the camera, and they appear slightly blurred due to motion. They are positioned between two shelves filled with products.

objects.label: shelf
objects.observation: Metal shelving units line both sides of the aisle, filled with various products including canned drinks and snack packages. The left shelf holds mostly cans, while the right has bags and boxes. Some sections have wire baskets attached.

objects.label: hot air balloon decorations
objects.observation: Several decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling, suspended by wires. They are colorful and appear to be made of fabric or plastic. One green-and-white balloon is near the top left, another pink-and-white is centered, and a yellow one is near the top right.

objects.label: canned beverages
objects.observation: Rows of colorful canned beverages are displayed on the left shelf. Cans feature purple, teal, and pink hues. They are arranged neatly on multiple levels of the shelf, with some stacked vertically.

objects.label: promotional sign
objects.observation: A red rectangular sign with white Chinese characters hangs above the aisle in the background. It is mounted to the ceiling or wall and partially obscured by the person walking below it. The text appears to promote a beverage brand.

objects.label: refrigerated section
objects.observation: A glass-fronted refrigerated display case is visible at the end of the aisle in the background. It contains various chilled products, though details are indistinct due to distance and blur. The case is framed by the surrounding shelves.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000023", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
